segments.text: This Office it ſelf to which Chriſt was called, is threefold, of a Prophet, of Prieſt, & of a King: this number and order of Offices is ſhewed; firſt, by mens neceſſities grievouſly labouring under ignorance, by reaſon whereof they ſtand in infinit neceſſity of the Prophetical office of Chriſt to relieve them. Secondly, alienation frō God, wherein they ſtand in need of the Prieſtly Office to reconcile them: Thirdly, our utter diſability to return to him, by which they ſtand in need of the power of Chriſt in his Kingly Office to aſſiſt and govern them.
